title: Auto-release
autoReleaseHint: Run the timer. Off stops release and the automatic cleanup; the button below still works.
deletePiHint: Also delete pi transcripts when deleting agents. Off deletes Paseo records only.
deleteWorkspacesHint: Delete every archived workspace, with the agents inside it.
deleteAgentsHint: Delete every archived agent, even in a workspace that is not archived.
privacyDescription: Delete every archived workspace, agent and project now, plus orphan pi sessions while pi session files are on. Irreversible.
tickHint: Releases runtimes and runs the cleanup.
graceHint: Skip runtimes touched this recently. 0 releases on the tick.
cleanupHint: How often the cleanup may run.
archivedWillDelete: Archived items are deleted at the next cleanup. Cannot be undone.
